In today’s competitive business landscape, capturing the attention of potential customers at the earliest stage of their buyer’s journey is more crucial than ever. To achieve this, you must have a solid “top-of-funnel” content strategy. This comprehensive guide will take you through every aspect of top-of-funnel marketing – from its importance and key elements to finding topics and creating engaging content that generates quality leads and rewards your brand with long-term loyalty. So let’s dive right in and start exploring the realm of top-of-the-funnel content creation!

## What is Top-of-Funnel (TOFU) Marketing? [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#0-toc-title)

Top-of-funnel (TOFU) marketing refers to the initial phase of a customer’s journey when they first become aware of your brand or product. It involves [creating content and strategies to attract potential customers](https://seowind.io/content-brief/) who may need to become familiar with your offering but could eventually become loyal clients.

The goal during this stage is to create valuable content that addresses your [target audience’s](https://seowind.io/docs/target-audience-what-is-it-and-how-to-define-it/) pain points, interests, and questions while sparking curiosity about your products or services. By catering to their needs through informative and engaging materials like [blog posts](https://seowind.io/how-long-should-blog-post-be/), videos, infographics, podcasts, etc., you can pique their interest and encourage them to explore further down the sales funnel.

High-funnel marketing allows you to understand better who your best-fit customers are by monitoring user engagement metrics from the top of-funnel strategy implementation. Ultimately, it plays an instrumental role in laying a strong foundation for building lasting relationships with prospects, which later translate into conversions as they continue their buying journey.

## Why is Top-of-Funnel Marketing Important? [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#1-toc-title)

The importance of top-of-funnel marketing cannot be overstated. It is the first crucial step in building a strong foundation for any successful marketing campaign. In this section, we’ll explore the four main reasons top-of-funnel marketing is vital: increasing brand awareness, improving [lead generation](https://seowind.io/docs/lead-generation-your-key-to-success/), facilitating customer engagement, and generating quality leads.

### Increase Brand Awareness [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#2-toc-title)

Attracting [potential customers to your business](https://seowind.io/docs/email-marketing-unlock-your-business-potential/) requires making them aware of your company’s existence. That’s where top-of-funnel marketing comes into play. By strategically placing engaging content on various platforms, you create visibility and assert your brand among prospects. This makes it easier for people to remember your company when they need what you offer or recommend it to others in their network. Ultimately, increased brand awareness aids business growth and opens opportunities for larger market shares.

### Improve Lead Generation [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#3-toc-title)

Lead generation is essential for businesses looking to expand their customer base consistently. With high-quality top-funnel content in place, attracting more leads becomes easier as such content targets a broader audience: those who might need to learn about your products or services but are interested in related information. By providing helpful resources that cater to this initial curiosity stage, you are positioning yourself well within potential customers’ minds as they progress through the buying journey.

### Facilitate Customer Engagement [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#4-toc-title)

Effective top-of-funnel marketing encourages meaningful interaction between your target audience and your brand. Through thought-provoking [blog posts](https://seowind.io/ai-blog-post-generator/), captivating videos, and engaging social media interactions – you name it – prospective clients become increasingly involved with your business’s message and mission. These engagements build the trust and rapport necessary for fostering loyalty among new customers once they’ve opted into the later stages of the sales funnel.

### Generate Quality Leads [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#5-toc-title)

Top funnel strategies focus on generating leads and ensuring that these leads are relevant and valuable to the business’s overall goals. By tailoring content specifically for those at the initial stages of their buying journey, you increase the likelihood of attracting quality leads who are genuinely interested in your product or service. In turn, these high-quality leads are more likely to convert into paying customers and generate a higher return on investment.

## Key Elements of Top-of-Funnel Marketing Content [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#6-toc-title)

[Creating content](https://seowind.io/docs/evergreen-content-magic-create-content-that-lasts/) for the top-of-the-funnel (TOFU) involves crafting engaging and eye-catching material that will draw your target audience’s attention. The goal is to generate awareness, interest, and engagement with your brand at this stage in the [marketing funnel](https://seowind.io/docs/marketing-funnel-what-it-is-and-how-it-works/). To [create an effective TOFU content strategy](https://seowind.io/seo-friendly-content/), consider incorporating these five key elements into your work.

### Visual Appeal [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#7-toc-title)

One crucial aspect of crafting compelling top-of-funnel content is strong visual appeal. Eye-catching visuals are much more likely to capture your audience’s attention and stand out from a crowded digital space than plain text alone. Some methods for boosting visual appeal include:

- Using high-quality images or illustrations that align with your branding
- Employing bold typography and color schemes that command attention
- Creating infographics or data visualizations to present information in an easy-to-digest format
- Incorporating videos or GIFs where appropriate

Using visually appealing components within your content can significantly increase its shareability and engagement rates.

### Engaging Stories [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#8-toc-title)

Tell engaging stories is a powerful way to captivate your audience’s attention. Sharing relatable experiences or emotional accounts helps create a personal connection between the reader and your brand. Consider incorporating storytelling in various parts of your TOFU content:

- Crafting narratives around common customer pain points
- Sharing testimonials or case studies directly from customers
- Utilizing metaphors or analogies relevant to your industry
- Offering behind-the-scenes glimpses into company processes or employee stories

Storytelling can ignite emotion in readers, driving higher levels of interest, trust, and loyalty toward your brand.

### Customer Focused Message [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#9-toc-title)

Focusing on potential customers is essential when creating TOFU content since it allows you to address their needs, concerns, and interests. To center your message around them:

1. Identify key demographics within your target audience
2. Determine relevant pain points, needs, and desires of those demographics
3. Craft content that directly addresses these findings

By prioritizing customer interests, your content will be much more likely to resonate with the reader and prompt them to take further action.

### Call to Action [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#10-toc-title)

Top-of-funnel content should include a clear and concise call to action (CTA) that guides readers toward the next desired step in their journey with your brand. A good CTA should be:

- Specific: Clearly communicate what you want the reader to do
- Compelling: Encourage the reader to act by offering benefits or incentives for taking action
- Aligned with TOFU goals: Indicate how taking this action relates to their initial engagement at the top of the funnel

Some examples of common CTAs you may use are: “Download our free e-book,” “Follow us on social media,” or “Sign up for our newsletter.”

### Sharing Options [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#11-toc-title)

To maximize reach, it is vital to make sharing your content as easy as possible for visitors. The ability to share information quickly can generate additional website traffic and qualified leads interested in your company’s offerings. To facilitate seamless sharing:

- Add social share buttons prominently displayed within blog articles or landing pages
- Optimize email templates with clickable “share” or “forward” options embedded
- Ensure mobile-friendliness so content can be shared across devices easily

Pushing your audience toward engaging with and distributing your content will ultimately help cultivate stronger brand awareness through broader visibility online.

## Top of Funnel Measurement and Metrics [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#12-toc-title)

In any [marketing strategy](https://seowind.io/content-repurposing/), measuring success is essential to determine the effectiveness of your efforts and make data-driven decisions for future improvements. The same applies to top-of-the-funnel (TOFU) marketing. In this section, we’ll explore two crucial metrics to measure success in TOFU marketing: Fast Lane Goal and Slow Lane Goal.

### Fast Lane Goal [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#13-toc-title)

The Fast Lane Goal focuses primarily on driving immediate conversions due to your top-of-funnel marketing efforts. These quick wins may vary depending on your industry or business objectives but often include:

- Actions like signing up for a newsletter.
- Requesting a trial.
- Downloading a resource such as an [eBook](https://seowind.io/how-to-write-an-ebook-ai/) or whitepaper.

To successfully track your Fast Lane Goals, consider implementing these strategies:

- Use analytics tools like Google Analytics to measure conversion rates and identify high-performing channels.
- Trigger goal tracking when visitors complete desired actions.
- Analyze demographic data on converters (age, gender, location) to tailor content further for targeted segments.

### Slow Lane Goal [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#14-toc-title)

While Fast Lane Goals provide instant gratification through short-term results, it’s essential to pay attention to the importance of Slow Lane Goals in top-of-funnel marketing. These goals focus on nurturing relationships with potential customers over time by [providing valuable content](https://seowind.io/serp-keywords/) that appeals to their interests and needs.

Here are some examples of Slow Lane Goals:

- Increasing brand awareness by creating compelling visual assets optimized for social sharing
- Encouraging customer engagement through blog comments and fostering community forum discussions
- Growing social media followership that leads to long-term advocates who share brand messages organically

Measuring slow lane success can be challenging due to less-defined actions than fast lane goals. However, consistently monitoring specific metrics will help you determine the impact of your upper-funnel marketing:

1. **Engagement Rates:** Monitor likes, shares, and comments on blogs and social media platforms where you’re publishing visual assets and content. High engagement rates indicate your audience finds your content relevant, engaging, and shareable.
2. **Organic Search Traffic:** Track organic growth in search engine results pages (SERPs) to ensure you’re efficiently targeting topics and keywords that resonate with your target market.
3. **Social Media Follower Growth:** Measure the number of new followers, likes, and mentions on social media platforms over time to evaluate the success of your customer connection-building strategies.

Understanding various metrics to measure both Fast Lane and Slow Lane Goals in top-of-funnel marketing enables businesses to allocate resources wisely, continually refine strategies, effectively generate leads, and build lasting relationships with potential customers – all while increasing overall return on investment (ROI).

## Top of Funnel Marketing Strategies [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#15-toc-title)

Creating an effective top-of-funnel marketing strategy is essential for engaging your target audience, educating them about your brand and products, nurturing their interest, and ultimately guiding them through the conversion process. This section will explore three key top-funnel marketing strategies: crafting compelling calls to action, capturing emails, and sparking engagement.

### Compelling Call to Action [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#16-toc-title)

A call to action (CTA) is crucial in any [marketing content](https://seowind.io/content-marketing-statistics/) that invites prospects to take a specific action related to your business offering. A persuasive CTA can make all the difference in turning casual readers into potential customers. Here are some best practices for creating compelling CTAs in your top-of-funnel content:

1. Make it clear and concise: Your CTA should be short and direct so that users know exactly what you’re asking them to do. For example, “Join our free webinar” or “Download our e-book.”
2. Use persuasive language: Encourage users to act by using actionable verbs like “get,” “try,” or “learn.” This communicates a sense of immediacy.
3. Create a sense of urgency: Phrases such as “limited-time offer” or “exclusive deal” can entice users who fear missing out on valuable opportunities.
4. Test multiple variations: Experiment with different copy, imagery, layout, and placement options to determine which version of your CTA generates the most conversions.

### Email Capture [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#17-toc-title)

Capturing visitors’ email addresses is critical for building a strong mailing list and nurturing leads through personalized communication. Including email capture functionality within your TOFU marketing assets lets you obtain contact information from interested prospects who want to learn more about your offerings. Some popular methods for incorporating email capture into your content include:

- Offering gated content: Providing valuable resources—such as whitepapers, e-books, or reports—that require users to submit their email addresses before gaining access.
- Hosting webinars: Encourage participants to register with their email addresses to attend live or on-demand sessions.
- Using pop-up forms: Strategically timed pop-ups can effectively prompt users for their email addresses while they are browsing your site.

Each approach allows you to obtain contact information from potential prospects, enabling you to provide future marketing materials and maintain a relationship throughout the sales cycle.

### Spark Engagement [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#18-toc-title)

A successful top-of-funnel strategy maintains user engagement by providing value, eliciting curiosity, and encouraging interaction. Implementing interactive elements helps create an engaging experience that keeps visitors invested in your content. Some tactics to enhance engagement include:

1. Use intriguing headlines: Eye-catching titles pique interest, prompting visitors to read more about your offering.
2. Share relevant content: Ensure that all content is tailored towards solving your target audience’s pressing challenges and provides actionable advice.
3. Incorporate multimedia: Diversify your content presentation using visual representations (infographics), audio (podcasts), or video formats—making it more appealing and easier to consume.
4. Encourage social sharing: Add social media buttons that allow easy sharing of your content across multiple networks, increasing visibility and reach.

By embracing compelling CTAs, strategically capturing emails, and sparking visitor engagement when developing top-of-the-funnel marketing strategies, you’ll be better positioned to [expand brand awareness](https://seowind.io/docs/brand-positioning/), generate high-quality leads, and grow your business in today’s competitive marketplace.

## How to Find Top Funnel Content Topics [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#19-toc-title)

Creating top-of-funnel content is crucial for [maximizing your digital marketing](https://seowind.io/benefits-sample-content-marketing-plan-digital-strategy/) efforts. To effectively engage and attract potential customers, producing captivating content that aligns with their needs and interests is vital. This section’ll explore several methods for discovering topics perfect for your top-of-funnel [content strategy](https://seowind.io/content-strategy/).

### Survey Customers [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#20-toc-title)

The most accurate way to understand what your target audience cares about is by asking them directly. Conducting surveys or polls on your website or social media platforms allows you to gather valuable insights into the questions, challenges, and preferences of existing clients and potential prospects. By asking open-ended questions about their experiences or opinions about your business niche, you can uncover new topics that will resonate with your audience in top-funnel marketing campaigns.

### Use Google Suggest [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#21-toc-title)

Google Suggest offers a readily available source of inspiration for upper-funnel marketing ideas. When typing a query into the search bar, Google provides suggestions based on popular phrases typed by other users, thereby shedding light on trending subjects and common user queries within your industry. For instance, consider focusing on broad terms such as “how-to” guides or pertinent issues users face in specific demographics when creating high-funnel [marketing content](https://seowind.io/docs/content-marketing-what-you-need-to-know/).

### Keyword Research [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#22-toc-title)

Conducting [keyword research](https://seowind.io/keyword-research-tips/) should be a priority when building a funnel filled with relevant top-of-the-funnel material. Keyword research involves finding words and phrases commonly searched by those interested in a brand’s products/services or industry. Many online tools like Moz’s Keyword Explorer, Google Trends, and Ahrefs’ Keywords Explorer can help identify popular keywords connected to your niche.

Once you’ve identified high-ranking keywords related to your business offerings:

1. Notice patterns among the results.
2. Identify [long-tail keywords](https://seowind.io/docs/long-tail-keywords-what-are-they-how-to-find-them/) that signal users early in their journey toward conversion.
3. Look for opportunities where competitors have left gaps in upper funnel content.

Using this information, create content focusing on these keywords and serving as a comprehensive resource for your target audience.

### Quora Top Ranking Pages for Keywords [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#23-toc-title)

In addition to traditional keyword research, platforms like Quora are an excellent source of inspiration for top-of-funnel topics. As a popular Q&A site, Quora hosts numerous discussions encompassing various subjects and interests that reflect the needs of your clientele. By studying the platform’s top-ranking pages connected to specific keywords, you can:

1. Identify questions users repeatedly ask.
2. Note suggestions from industry experts.
3. Assess any misconceptions prevalent among potential clients.

By addressing these inquiry-driven trends and issues in your top-funnel marketing strategy, you’re likely to produce content that genuinely benefits your prospects while propelling them further down the sales process.

## Top of Funnel Examples [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#24-toc-title)

Understanding different types of top-of-funnel [content is essential for crafting an effective marketing strategy](https://seowind.io/content-marketing-for-ecommerce/). This section will explore various examples of top-funnel marketing, including landing pages, blog posts, videos, social media posts, infographics, and podcasts. Incorporating these content formats into your marketing efforts can help drive brand awareness and generate high-quality leads.

### Landing Pages [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#25-toc-title)

A well-designed landing page is the gateway to your website or offer. It plays a crucial role in top-of-the-funnel marketing strategies. These pages should be visually appealing and provide clear and concise information about your product or service offerings. Include compelling headlines, engaging copy, customer-focused messaging, and strong calls-to-action (CTAs) that entice visitors to take the desired action, such as signing up for a newsletter or purchasing.

### Blog Posts [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#26-toc-title)

[Blog posts are an excellent way](https://seowind.io/how-to-write-blog-posts-for-seo/) to showcase your industry expertise and attract visitors searching for valuable information on topics related to your niche. A top-of-the-funnel blog post should focus on providing helpful insights while subtly promoting your brand’s products or services. Some key elements of a successful blog post include:

- Compelling headlines that pique interest
- Easily scannable text with subheadings and bullet points
- Engaging storytelling with real-life examples
- Shareability through social sharing buttons
- Relevant internal/external links for further resources

Incorporate upper funnel marketing keywords within your content to improve search engine visibility and capture organic traffic.

### Videos [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#27-toc-title)

Videos have become an increasingly popular format for consuming content as they deliver information visually and engagingly. Creating informative videos on relevant industry topics lets you quickly demonstrate your expertise while entertaining potential customers. Scripts should be concise yet engaging—covering key points without overwhelming the viewer—and supported by visuals like graphics or animations.

### Social Media Posts [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#28-toc-title)

Social media platforms are ideal for reaching a wider audience and creating viral top-funnel marketing campaigns. Crafting engaging, shareable social media content can include:

- Eye-catching visuals that communicate your message quickly
- Short, snappy captions or tweets to pique curiosity
- Use of relevant hashtags for increased visibility
- A clear call to action directing users toward a specific web page

Remember to tap into trending topics within your industry and offer insightful commentary on social media, further boosting brand awareness.

### Infographics [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#29-toc-title)

Infographics combine visual appeal with valuable information in an easily digestible format, making them an ideal top-of-the-funnel content type. Incorporating data-driven insights or research findings alongside appealing graphics solidifies your position as an authority while offering share-worthy material that can quickly circulate among potential customers.

### Podcasts [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#30-toc-title)

Podcasts are gaining popularity, providing audio-based content for audiences who prefer listening over reading or watching. By hosting a podcast or collaborating with influential members within your industry—discussing hot topics or conducting informative interviews—you create TOFU marketing content that informs, builds trust, and fosters lasting relationships with future customers.

In summary, incorporating these diverse forms of top-funnel marketing examples into your overall strategy will help drive brand awareness and generate high-quality leads efficiently. Tailor each piece of content to your target audience’s needs and preferences while ensuring the inclusion of strong CTAs and cohesive messaging.

## Make the Relationship Funnel Official [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#31-toc-title)

When it comes to top-of-funnel (TOFU) marketing, creating a strong connection between your brand and potential customers is crucial. This initial connection lays the groundwork for building a long-lasting relationship throughout the sales funnel. Establishing an official relationship funnel can help streamline your TOFU marketing efforts while concurrently fostering customer loyalty and trust. Let’s delve into some key factors that contribute to making your relationship funnel official.

### Establish Trust with Transparency [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#32-toc-title)

To create a successful top-of-funnel strategy, you must establish trust early in the customer journey. Transparent communication is essential when acquiring new customers because it cultivates reliability and authenticity. Be upfront about what potential clients can expect from your company, share case studies demonstrating previous successes, and consider displaying client testimonials as social proof of your credibility.

### Address Potential Pain Points [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#33-toc-title)

Addressing pain points or challenges faced by prospective customers ensures you’re providing value from the beginning of their experience with your brand—essential for top-of-the-funnel marketing success. To do so:

- Identify common problems within your target audience
- Highlight possible solutions offered by your product or service
- Share helpful tips through content such as blog posts, videos, or infographics

By addressing these issues early on, you’ll demonstrate expertise in your industry and showcase why choosing your brand over competitors is advantageous.

### Personalize Your Approach [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#34-toc-title)

Customizing interactions with audiences allows for deeper connections during the TOFU stage while enhancing prospects’ affinity toward your brand as they navigate the sales process. Examples of personalization include:

- Segmenting leads based on demographic information or purchase history
- Crafting tailored messaging across various channels (such as email campaigns)
- Utilizing conversational tools like chatbots to deliver customized experiences

Personalized engagement fosters emotional connections between consumers and brands, resulting in higher lead conversions.

### Continuous Nurturing Through Engagement [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#35-toc-title)

Creating a strong TOFU presence requires continuous customer nurturing. To engage your audience and maintain their interest, consider the following tactics:

- Frequently update content to remain relevant and informative
- Participate in active conversations on social media platforms or community forums relating to your industry
- Offer value-added incentives like promotions or discounts for new customers

By consistently nurturing potential clients throughout the top-of-funnel phase, you’ll effectively set yourself apart from competitors while guiding prospects further down the sales funnel.

Establishing an official relationship funnel is fundamental for successful TOFU marketing strategies. By prioritizing transparency, addressing pain points, personalizing messaging, and continuously nurturing relationships with potential customers, you will create a solid foundation for attracting and retaining high-quality leads that contribute to business growth.

## FAQ [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#36-toc-title)

### What does top-of-funnel mean in business? [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#37-toc-title)

Top of the funnel (TOFU) refers to the initial stage of the customer journey in a business context. It is the phase where potential customers become aware of a brand or its products and services. At this stage, their awareness may be triggered by various means, such as online searches, social media exposure, or recommendations from their friends or network. During the top-of-the-funnel stage, businesses’ primary goal is to [create content and implement marketing strategies](https://seowind.io/content-brief/) that attract prospects and convert them into leads.

Relevant keywords: top of the funnel, upper funnel marketing

### What does the top-of-the-funnel content mean? [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#38-toc-title)

Top-of-the-funnel content is specifically created to attract new prospects who may still need to become familiar with your brand or are just beginning their research process. This type of content aims to entertain, inform, and engage potential customers, offering valuable insights without directly promoting your product or service. Examples include [educational blog posts](https://seowind.io/educational-content-writing/), videos, infographics, ebooks, whitepapers, webinars, or engaging social media posts.

The primary purpose of top-of-the-funnel content is to provide value while establishing trust and authority with your target audience. By doing this effectively, you can lay a strong foundation for guiding these potential leads through each subsequent phase in your sales and marketing funnels.

Relevant keywords: top-of-funnel strategy, high-funnel marketing

### What is the top of the funnel in content marketing? [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/top-of-the-funnel-content-creation/\#39-toc-title)

In content marketing, the top of the funnel refers to an approach focusing on creating informative and engaging materials designed to attract prospective buyers at every stage of their decision-making process within different target segments. This process begins with intriguing and relevant information which grabs users’ attention but does not overwhelm them with expectations for immediate commitment.

A successful TOFU campaign captivates users’ interest while informing them about available solutions provided by your industry without resorting to hard-selling tactics but relying on the [content quality](https://seowind.io/ai-article-generator/) of information, authenticity, and educating them about your products and services. With time, the customer’s trust in your brand is consolidated, generating strong credibility within your marketplace.

Relevant keywords: funnel marketing strategy, top-of-funnel marketing
